title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy vintage show featuring a blistering Speedway Boogie and tight China > Rider, with overall good sound though recording details are unclear.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the ferocious playing that carries through to the final note of Lovelight and praise this performance as their favorite version of Speedway Boogie, complete with the 'Nobody's Fault' jam. The set also delivers strong renditions of Schoolgirl, New Speedway Boogie, and a seamless China > Rider transition, making it a standout vintage recording despite the lack of specific recording‑quality comments.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave high marks (average 4.7 stars) and highlighted multiple standout performances; no negative points were raised, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments about sound quality were provided in the reviews.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert maintains a high‑energy flow, highlighted by tight transitions such as China > Rider and an intense finish on Lovelight, with the standout jam‑filled Speedway Boogie anchoring the set.
